LanguageInfo must be instantiated in get_language_info() match statement
Language must be added to get_ts_language() function
Module must be declared in mod.rs and exported
test_coverage: Existing language modules include: element extraction (functions, classes, interfaces, enums), call site detection, import extraction, type reference extraction, inheritance extraction (extends/implements), def-use site analysis. PHP tests should cover all these dimensions.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; node types: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration; field names: name, body, base_clause, class_interface_clause
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields. Class and interface declarations have name field and body field. Functions are function_definition nodes. Methods are method_declaration nodes within class bodies.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query API for tree-sitter pattern matching; Node methods: child_by_field_name(), child(), parent(), kind(), start_byte(), end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Queries use S-expression syntax with @capture names. Field names are grammar-specific and must match node-types.json.

approaches.name: Full PHP Language Support (Recommended)
approaches.description: Add complete PHP language handler with all optional features: element extraction (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, enums), call detection, import extraction, type references, inheritance extraction, and def-use analysis. Create php.rs module with all query constants and handler functions, register in mod.rs and lang.rs, add tree-sitter-php dependency, add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP, add integration tests.
pros: Comprehensive feature parity with other language handlers
Enables def-use site analysis for semantic extraction
Covers all PHP declaration kinds: functions, methods, classes, interfaces, enums
Provides call site detection for method/function invocations
cons: Requires writing tree-sitter queries for all node types
Requires implementing extract_inheritance handler to walk base_clause/class_interface_clause

approaches.name: Minimal PHP Support (CSS-like)
approaches.description: Add basic PHP handler with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY, no inheritance, no def-use analysis. Similar to CSS handler. Covers function and class extraction only. Minimal test coverage.
cons: Incomplete feature set compared to Java/Kotlin/Go

approaches.name: Phased Approach (Phase 1: Elements + Calls)
approaches.description: Start with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only (Phase 1), then add REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY in Phase 2, and DEFUSE_QUERY + extract_inheritance in Phase 3. Each phase is a separate PR.
pros: Easier to debug issues per phase

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full PHP Language Support). The issue asks for 'PHP language support via tree-sitter-php' without specifying scope limits. Full support aligns with the project's pattern of comprehensive language handlers (Java, Kotlin, Go all have complete feature sets). The tree-sitter-php grammar is mature and well-documented. The additional complexity of inheritance extraction (base_clause/class_interface_clause traversal) and def-use analysis is manageable and follows established patterns from other handlers. A single well-tested PR is preferable to phased rollout for a new language.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function

(class_declaration

(interface_declaration

inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node in PHP tree-sitter grammar: (1) check for optional base_clause child node (contains 'extends' keyword followed by parent class name(s)); (2) check for optional class_interface_clause child node (contains 'implements' keyword followed by interface name(s)); (3) each clause contains name nodes that are the parent/interface identifiers; (4) walk the class_declaration node's children, identify base_clause and class_interface_clause by kind(), extract all name children from each, and format as 'extends ParentName' and 'implements InterfaceName' strings. Source: tree-sitter-php grammar rule class_declaration in common/define-grammar.js shows optional($.base_clause) and optional($.class_interface_clause) as child nodes, not fields.
